entries.title: HRMS - Leave Policy
entries.text: [1790000000001] HRMS - Leave Policy The HRMS leave policy allows every employee 24 paid leave days per year. Earned leave (EL) accrues at 2 days per month and can be carried forward up to 30 days. Sick leave is 12 days per year and does not require prior approval, but employees must inform their manager before 10am on the day of absence. Maternity leave is 26 weeks and paternity leave is 15 days. Leave requests must be submitted in the HRMS portal at least 48 hours in advance and are approved or rejected by the reporting manager within 2 working days.

entries.title: HRMS - Payroll & Attendance
entries.text: [1790000000002] HRMS - Payroll & Attendance The HRMS payroll runs on the 1st of every month. Salaries are credited directly to the employee bank account and the payslip is available in the HRMS portal by the 3rd. Attendance is captured by biometric swipe; a late arrival beyond 15 minutes marks half-day casual leave. A full day of work is 8 hours and 30 minutes. Employees must complete 21 working days in a month to qualify for full salary, otherwise salary is prorated. Special allowances like conveyance and medical are paid only if confirmed in the offer letter.
